name: Box Blitz
author: Addicting Games
description: Back and forth, back and forth, move the box back and forth. Avoid the spikes. Avoid the spikes, the box keeps going back and forth as long as you avoid the spikes. There's a rhythm to this game, how long can you keep up the delicate dance? Click to jump from side to side, earn some coins to modify your experience and climb to the top.
